description: This file defines the SkillAPI class which is a part of the OrangeHRM system's admin API. It provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing skills, including methods for fetching, listing, creating, updating, and deleting skill records. It interacts with the SkillService and uses models and DTOs to structure data, and contains OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: SkillAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoints for CRUD operations on Skill entities within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and listing skills, with integrated validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the SkillService instance used to perform business logic related to skills.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Skill entity by ID and returns it encapsulated in a SkillModel; throws RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of skills based on search filters, sorting, and pagination, returning a collection result with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Skill by instantiating a Skill entity, validating input, and saving it, then returning the created skill as a SkillModel.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Skill identified by ID with new data from request, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple skills by IDs provided in the request body.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Populates a Skill entity with data from request parameters and saves it through the SkillService.
